calculation.description: Twenty-session price momentum multiplied by ten-session directional efficiency. Positive values reward persistent upward drift; choppy paths are attenuated, while negative values identify persistent downward drift. Computed using data available through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.036841), 2023-2024 (+0.028612), and 2025-2027 (+0.016607). Longer-horizon decay was stronger than the one-day horizon. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative sizing.
